title: Baseline and ownership
summary: RPC Service Core dev1, JSON-RPC Fabric dev3, SOAP RPC Binding dev2 and gRPC RPC Binding dev3 are distinct components. RPC Portfolio v0.1-dev1 was transferred to GitHub Autobuild, but receipt/acceptance was not observed. There is no pre-existing RPC Invocation sphere in the inspected GitHub sphere catalogue.
invariants: Source candidates are not automatically runtime-accepted.
A service method definition is transport-neutral; a protocol binding only projects it over a particular envelope.
Queue Fabric remains the preferred durable execution connector when its semantics are required, never a mandatory RPC implementation dependency.

provenance.claim: Source inspected locally in exact package bytes.
